svg.title: Water hexamer in a rectangular real-space grid
svg.desc: Six water molecules from published coordinates, with six red oxygens and twelve smaller white hydrogens, in a transparent rectangular Cartesian domain. Only the twelve intramolecular O–H bonds are solid; geometrically verified hydrogen bonds are thin dashed lines.
svg.metadata: {"source_page": "https://www-wales.ch.cam.ac.uk/~wales/CCD/anant-watcl.html", "coordinate_url": "https://www-wales.ch.cam.ac.uk/~wales/CCD/anant/xyz/6-prism.xyz", "doi": "10.1021/jp013141b", "coordinate_file": "6-prism.xyz", "coordinate_sha256": "c8aea2650b212aaf172f5dc779040aee9ade00c8424b2f4ed51f766e0fd805a6", "geometry": "Published RHF/6-31G(d,p) prism water-hexamer coordinates; rigid rotation, translation and uniform visual scaling only.", "domain": "Rectangular 6\u00d74\u00d73 domain with uniform Cartesian mesh; orthographic camera yaw45\u00b0, elevation20\u00b0.", "density": "Background teal haze is qualitative, not computed electron-density data."}
